user_story: As a guest, I want the system to reject an invalid date format so that only correctly formatted dates are accepted.

positive.title: Valid date format is accepted
steps: Navigate to the date input form.
Enter a date in the format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2023-10-21).
positive.expected_result: The system accepts the date and processes it successfully.

negative.title: Incorrect date format is rejected
steps: Navigate to the date input form.
Enter a date in the format DD-MM-YYYY (e.g., 21-10-2023).
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the date and displays an error message indicating the correct format.

negative.title: Non-date characters in the date field
steps: Navigate to the date input form.
Enter alphabets or symbols instead of a date (e.g., 'abcd-ef-gh' or '2023/10/21').
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the input and displays an error message indicating the correct format.

edge.title: Leap year date handling
steps: Navigate to the date input form.
Enter a leap year date in the format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2024-02-29).
edge.expected_result: The system accepts the leap year date and processes it successfully.

edge.title: End of month date handling
steps: Navigate to the date input form.
Enter the last day of a month (e.g., 2023-04-30).
edge.expected_result: The system accepts the date and processes it successfully.
